title: My Dog In Three Places
tests: Maintains the individual identity of a reference dog while changing its surroundings across three photorealistic images.

judge.summary: Three convincing square photos preserve the dog's recognisable appearance across all requested settings, with no significant visible problems.

must_haves.item: Three separate square, photorealistic images are delivered.
must_haves.why: Three separate square images are shown, each with realistic fur, textures and photographic depth of field.

must_haves.item: The dog's face, ears, muzzle, coat colour and build remain recognisably consistent with dog.jpg in all three.
must_haves.why: All three preserve the reference dog's facial proportions, floppy ears, broad dark nose, pale muzzle, golden coat and seated build.

must_haves.item: The locations are visibly a sandy beach, a snowy forest trail, and a cosy living room, one per image.
must_haves.why: The images clearly show sand beside ocean waves, a snow-covered trail through conifers, and a warmly lit room with a sofa, blanket and rug.

must_haves.item: The dog is naturally integrated into each setting with plausible scale, lighting and ground contact.
must_haves.why: The paws and seated body make credible contact with sand, snow and carpet, with plausible scale and lighting in each scene.

must_haves.item: The dog wears no clothes and the images contain no text.
must_haves.why: No clothing or visible text appears in any of the three outputs.
